name: What factors drive the overall cost of a whole-home remodel?

mainEntity.name: What factors drive the overall cost of a whole-home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The overall cost of a full home remodel depends primarily on square footage, the extent of structural alterations, and your choice of finishes and fixtures. Tearing down load-bearing walls for an open layout, moving plumbing lines in bathrooms or kitchens, and adding custom cabinetry will significantly influence the total investment compared to cosmetic surface updates. Establishing clear priorities across each room and finalizing your material selections early helps prevent unexpected budget overruns during construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on home size, structural floor plan changes, moving plumbing or electrical lines, and the level of custom cabinetry, fixtures, and finishes selected.
